استفسرن (form X)
# اِسْتَفْسَرْنَ (istafsarna) /is.taf.sar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَفْسَرَ (istafsara)
# اُسْتُفْسِرْنَ (ustufsirna) /us.tuf.sir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَفْسَرَ (istafsara)
# اِسْتَفْسِرْنَ (istafsirna) /is.taf.sir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَفْسَرَ (istafsara)
